newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: Venezuela foreign reserves rise to $14.87 bln.
newsitem.headline: Venezuela foreign reserves rise to $14.87 bln.

text.p: Venezuela's total foreign reserves rose $477 million, or 3.3 percent, in the week to November 11 to $14.873 billion, according to new figures released by the central bank.
Reserves were up from $14.396 billion on November 4, the bank's latest weekly bulletin of indicators showed.
Levels were up $5.171 billion, or 53 percent, from reserve levels of $9.702 billion on April 19 -- the last working day before exchange levels were lifted on Monday April 22.
That rise, in large part due to higher than expected international oil prices, exceeds the government target agreed with the IMF of $1.5 billion increase by year-end.
The sustained rise has complicated monetary policy, government officials have said, increasing liquidity and thus inflationary pressures.
